templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from replicated-grid by the note-writer: this is a three-band privilege-level stack (L2, L1, L0) with one numbered fault-and-fix path stepping down and back up; there is no set of repeated peer nodes and no ellipsis anywhere.
templates.what_to_learn: Treat this as a control-loop figure instead: stack the three privilege bands top to bottom, and let one circled 1-5 sequence travel down through the fault handlers and back up, rather than expecting any part of it to show replicated peers.
